Name: Drusilla
Summary: Drusilla was a Herodian princess, wife of the governor Felix, who sat beside him while Paul spoke about faith in Christ, righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come.
KeyStory: Felix sent for Paul with Drusilla beside him, and trembled at the sermon about judgment, then sent Paul away.
LifeLesson: Hearing about judgment should tremble us into action, not into postponement. Drusilla and Felix put Paul off until a more convenient season.
